import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features (drop Id and target)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y = train_df["Cover_Type"].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values

# Check class distribution to diagnose
unique, counts = np.unique(y, return_counts=True)
print("Class distribution:", dict(zip(unique, counts)))

# Use stratified split to preserve class distributions
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y, shuffle=True
)

# Safeguard: ensure all classes are present in training set
missing_classes = set(y) - set(y_train)
if missing_classes:
    for cls in missing_classes:
        # Find indices of class cls in validation set
        val_indices = np.where(y_val == cls)[0]
        if len(val_indices) > 0:
            # Move one sample to training set
            idx = val_indices[0]
            X_train = np.vstack([X_train, X_val[idx : idx + 1]])
            y_train = np.concatenate([y_train, y_val[idx : idx + 1]])
            # Remove from validation set
            mask = np.ones(len(X_val), dtype=bool)
            mask[idx] = False
            X_val = X_val[mask]
            y_val = y_val[mask]
    print(f"Moved {len(missing_classes)} missing classes from validation to training")

# LightGBM classifier
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    objective="multiclass",
    num_class=7,
    metric="multi_logloss",
    boosting_type="gbdt",
    num_leaves=63,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    feature_fraction=0.8,
    bagging_fraction=0.8,
    bagging_freq=5,
    verbose=-1,
    seed=42,
    n_estimators=200,
)

# Train model
model.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], eval_metric="multi_logloss")

# Validate
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission with integer Cover_Type (1-indexed as expected)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": sample_sub["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_pred.astype(int)})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
